Hi Samir / Lena —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick post-call recap and proposed next steps so we have a single place to align. Happy to jump on another 30-min call if helpful.

Call highlights (pain & goals)
- Primary pain: inconsistent audit visibility and short retention windows across current providers; compliance team needs 3+ years of tamper-evident audit logs for investigations and regulators.
- Business goal: integrate an inference platform that meets SOC 2 controls, provides exportable audit logs, and supports contractually guaranteed retention ranges.
- Risk tolerance: they need clear evidence (past pen-test summary, SOC 2 snapshot, DPA clause on retention & access) before procurement approval.

What we can provide (baseline)
- SOC 2 snapshot + scope summary (redacted): quick summary of control coverage and last assessment date.
- Audit log options: per-route token-level logs; options for 90d / 1yr / 3yr retention (we need to scope storage/archival costs).
- DPA & retention template language: we can share standard clauses and flag any asks that require legal review.
- Pen-test: we can share recent third-party pen-test scope summary and discuss scheduling an additional targeted assessment if required.

Actions & proposed owners
1) Evidence package (initial): SOC 2 snapshot, redacted pen-test scope summary, retention matrix — owner: Priyom Das (security). Target: Nov 9.
2) Commercial/Deployment: map Dedicated/private options + estimate delta for 3yr retention — owner: Karthik Iyer (eng/sales). Target: Nov 9.
3) CS/process: propose intake for future evidence requests and ongoing attestations — owner: Lauren Bishop (CS).
4) Follow-up call: propose Wed Nov 10 or Thu Nov 11 (30 min) to walk the package and address legal redlines — please confirm.

Attachments included: SOC2-snapshot-2026-09.pdf, Retention-matrix-v1.csv, PenTest-scope-draft.pdf

Open clarifying questions for you Samir:
- Is compliance asking specifically for 3 full years for all audit data, or is a 3-year window for metadata + 90 days raw logs acceptable?
- Any preferred packet redaction rules we should follow when sharing the pen-test output?

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Mina Haddad

Mina — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side after reviewing the attachments:

1) Retention requirement: Compliance lead says they need 3 years of audited event data for investigations. They would accept metadata indexed for 3 years with an on-demand cold-archive option for full raw payloads, but that needs contractual SLA for retrieval times (<= 72 hrs).

2) Pen-test: We can accept a redacted scope summary for initial review, but they will want evidence of remediation tracking (tickets) for any critical findings. If you can share the last test date and that remediation cadence, that helps.

3) DPA: legal would like to see a template DPA with a retention clause and a description of access controls (KMS, HSM, customer key options).

4) Deployment: we are evaluating a private VPC (for data isolation) vs Redwood Dedicated with dedicated capacity. Can you outline which plan supports customer-managed KMS/HSM and what the network diagram looks like for each?

Proposed next step: Wed Nov 10, 10:00 - 10:30 PT — quick walkthrough of the package + Q&A with Compliance and Legal (I will invite them if that time works).

Thanks,
Samir Khan
Director, Security & Compliance | FinServe Capital
